text: This remark is important: for many carpenters think the form and direction of the hitting joint of greater importance; and even the checks by not prosecuting the general principle through all its consequences, may be led into an order. The form of the joint is of no importance, in as far as it affects the strains in the direction of the beams, but it is often of pure consequence, in respect to its own firmness, and the effect it may have to brushing the piece on which it acts, or being crippled by it.
